title: Single hieratic sign, Turin, Museo Egizio, CGT 54051 (AKU HT 44692)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Giuseppina Lenzo; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 44692

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 44692; AKU grapheme E0140 (AKU GR 180). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: E9 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 143. Source publication of this facsimile: Lenzo 2011. Occurrence: line 5; find place Deir el-Medina; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 7.8 x 11.1 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 20. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Giuseppina Lenzo. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
